IncidentReport.title: IncidentReport
IncidentReport.description: Represents a reported golf course ball strike, damage, or near-miss incident.

id.description: Standardized ID for the incident report, format prefix: GIR-YYYY-XXXX

name.description: The name and unit number of the reporting resident.

dateTime.description: The date and time of the incident.

photoUrl.description: A Base64 data URL representing the photo of damage, or null if empty.

incidentType.description: The categorizing classification of the logged incident.

customDescription.description: The details filled in by the resident if incidentType is 'other'.

timestamp.description: The exact localized date and time when the report was recorded.

/incidents/{incidentId}.description: A collection storing all golf ball strike incident logs.
